## Summary

Describe the change and the concrete problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Bug fix without protocol-semantic change
- [ ] Reference implementation change
- [ ] Schema / wire-format change
- [ ] Protocol-semantic change
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Test / conformance change

## Protocol compatibility

- Affected HTP version(s):
- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Not applicable

If breaking, explain the migration/versioning impact.

## Trust / security impact

Does this change authority, provenance, evidence, lineage, replay behavior, signatures, publication profiles, privacy boundaries or source trust?

## Validation

- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] Trust-boundary changes include adversarial/failure tests
- [ ] Schemas/docs are updated when wire semantics change
- [ ] No hidden remote runtime dependency was introduced

## Independent implementation check

Could another implementation reproduce the intended behavior from the public HTP specification and test vectors alone?

## Notes

Add any unresolved tradeoffs, limitations or follow-up work.
